<!-- pr-reviewer: 68d317b789f4b5d31fcefef70550f1f80f77e0c6 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (reviewed at the high tier: stock simulation is under the safety floor).

**What looks good**
- The column arm is the old code call for call. I read the diff against the removed code: `CarriedStock::carry` is `Body::carry`; `simulate` is `cut::simulate(&mut b.dex, ..)` (the same call `Stock::Column` makes); `clip_columns_under` is the loop moved verbatim out of `stock_sim_carry::clip_to_setup_stock`; `Held::verdict` returns the same `(deviate, dex)` for a plain stock and the same `(body.deviate, body.display())` for a carried one; `PriorPlan` / `prior_state` / `rest/across::sweep` end in the same `dex` / `body` as before. Error strings are unchanged (`to_string` at the same seams).
- The engine defaults to `Backend::Column` (`stock_sim_held.rs`); the carried-body cache key is unchanged on the column arm (extra bytes only on the field arm), so no cached body or stamp moves.
- Field arm is safe by construction: cylinder stock refused by name, non-finite/unreadable columns refused, a cut-through column reads as empty-but-convicted rather than air. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the new modules.
- Leak law: no new components or global state. `Ceiling` grids and `FieldBody` are owned `Vec`/`Box` and drop with the held stock; the thread-local engine switch restores via a `Drop` guard; nothing is cached per entity beyond the existing carried-body cache (key only gains the engine on the field arm).
- No golden, snapshot PNG, CHANGELOG or process file touched; no build.rs / `.github` / scripts / dependency change. New modules carry provenance lines and stay under 400 lines. Decision file is in `docs/decisions/`. Body has `Changelog: none`, `Refs #637`.

**Local results** (trial merge with `upstream/main` 9032da34, clean, no conflicts; macOS)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --no-run` | builds (app lib tests compile) |
| sim: carried_stock (new) / carry_engine_agreement / stock_carry / stock_backend_parity / stock_sim | 6 / 12 / 7 / 13 / 24 passed |
| app: setup_carry / rest_across_setups / carried_verify / carried_fixtures_cache | 9 / 7 / 8 / 6 passed |
| app: stock_sim_document / remachining / suppressed_rest / top_stock / setup_stock_source / drill_prior / golden_cl | 9 / 6 / 2 / 4 / 8 / 12 / 25 passed |
| app: carried_engine_agreement (default lane) | 1 passed (heavy test ignored, as designed) |
| app lib `stock_sim` filter | 7 passed |
| Field arm (`CAMCRAFT_CARRY_ENGINE=field`): setup_carry / rest_across_setups / carried_verify | 9 / 7 / 8 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not run here: the release heavy lanes (`carried_engine_agreement -- --ignored`, `stock_engine_agreement -- --ignored`); I rely on the author's reported 0-delta results (a debug-built release lane was out of the time box). Also not run: ui suites (no ui change), Windows.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- On the field arm a cut-through column reports the gouge depth to the stock's floor rather than the tool's depth (documented in the PR); it still convicts, so no false clear. Worth keeping in view for #589 before the default flips.
- `Held::Plain(Stock::Field(_))` arms all return `PLAIN_FIELD_REFUSAL`; fine as unreachable-by-construction, and refused by name if ever hit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
